rule: No citation or novelty claim may be added without checking a primary source and matching BibTeX metadata.

verified_this_round.primary_source: arXiv:2606.25331v1 (2026-06-24), Improved Large Language Diffusion Models
verified_this_round.support: Defines a deterministic confidence-based multiple-choice scorer that repeatedly reveals the highest-confidence ground-truth candidate token and sums its log probabilities; explicitly calls the score a task-specific surrogate rather than a likelihood estimate; compares it with a likelihood-style baseline on PIQA, ARC-Challenge, and HellaSwag.
verified_this_round.boundary: Does not report the present paper's paired same-item protocol audit, nominal-draw versus forward-call accounting, random-mask budget curve, reveal-order comparison, or GSM8K-MC construction analysis.

verified_this_round.primary_source: NeurIPS 2025 proceedings paper, Large Language Diffusion Models
verified_this_round.support: Introduces LLaDA as a masked diffusion language model with a forward masking process and reverse masked-token prediction process.
verified_this_round.boundary: The checked source establishes the model family and formulation, not this paper's multiple-choice protocol comparison.

verified_this_round.primary_source: ICLR 2024 paper, Large Language Models Are Not Robust Multiple Choice Selectors (OpenReview shr9PXz7T0)
verified_this_round.support: Shows option-position changes can materially alter multiple-choice accuracy and studies option-ID selection bias across autoregressive LLMs.
verified_this_round.boundary: Does not study masked-diffusion ground-truth-token injection, confidence-ordered reveal schedules, or forward-count accounting.

verified_this_round.primary_source: NeurIPS 2024 proceedings paper, Simple and Effective Masked Diffusion Language Models, DOI 10.52202/079017-4135
verified_this_round.support: Provides masked-diffusion language-model objective and sampling background.
verified_this_round.boundary: Does not supply the closest empirical precedent for the present multiple-choice scoring-protocol audit.

resolved_consistency: The bibliography now matches the verified lock in identifying Large Language Diffusion Models as a NeurIPS 2025 proceedings paper; no unverified pages, volume, or proceedings identifier was added.
